findings.issue: The two requires share one revert tail in the bytecode; the text prints it once after the join, so the messages '77' and '82' are reachable only through the phi _20 and a string-copy loop, while the onlyPoolConfigurator require of the same function prints 'revert with '10''.
findings.rule: When a join block is a revert whose payload depends only on a phi of constants (here string pointers), duplicate it into each predecessor so that each revert folds to its constant ('revert with '77'', 'revert with '82''); a revert is a dead end, so the duplication cannot change other paths.
